title: delurio UI graph (ui.yaml)
description: What each state of a flow shows, in delurio-graph/0 (SPEC.md §4): the nodes of the screen, their WAI-ARIA roles, accessible names, visible texts and the events they send. Every word a user sees comes from the catalog, by key.

kind.description: The kind of graph file. A ui.yaml is `ui`.

id.description: The UI graph's id; its flow names it with `ui:`.

flow.description: The id of the flow whose states the nodes are shown in.

title.description: The UI graph in plain words, for people.

summary.description: What the screens are, in a few plain sentences.

catalog.description: The catalog the page uses, relative to this file: `catalog/<locale>.json`, a locale being a BCP 47 tag.

locales.description: The locales the UI is written in, as BCP 47 tags; each has a catalog beside `catalog`, named `<locale>.json`.

kit.description: The kit the screens are drawn with (SPEC.md §8), relative to the graph; `--kit` wins.

samples.description: Values for catalog parameters, on the page and in videos: `{client}` in a message is filled with `samples.client`.

changes.description: What the flow changes and what follows, in its users' own words: what is created, sent, charged or removed, who sees it, and whether it can be undone. Required under --strict when the flow's steps invoke a writing action of its domain.

key.description: The catalog key of the note; every locale's catalog must have it.

nodes.description: The nodes of the screens, by id. A node is shown in a state when the state is in `in`, not in `unless`, and `when` holds.

edges.description: Relations the page and the checks use: a node labelled by another, an action that leads to a state.

rules.description: Rules the screens must keep, in words. Written but no tool reads them yet (#3).

formatVersion.description: The format and its version. Every graph file starts with it.

status.description: `proposed`: written before or apart from the code, nobody has approved it. `captured`: read from existing code (capture mode, every element carries `source`). `approved`: the owner reviewed and accepted it.

identifier.description: An identifier of the graph: English camelCase (SPEC.md §1, Text).

stateRef.description: The id of a state of the flow.

nodeRef.description: The id of a node of this UI graph.

states.description: States of the flow, by id.

expression.description: An expression of delurio's own language (SPEC.md §3) over the flow's context: or, and, not, ==, !=, in, not in, ( ), [lists], 'strings', numbers, true, false, null, and names (a context variable, a named guard of the flow, or `state`).

sourceAnchor.description: A source anchor (SPEC.md §9): `<repo-relative path>:<line>`, or a bare `<path>` for a whole file, naming the code that draws the element.

label.$comment: exactly one of key, labelledBy, literal or oneOf
label.description: Words of a node, in one of these forms: `{ key, params }` from the catalog, `{ labelledBy: <node> }`, `{ literal }`, or `{ oneOf: [keys] }`.

key.description: The catalog key of the message.

params.description: The data each `{param}` of the message stands for (e.g. `client: client.name`); the page fills it from `samples`.

additionalProperties.description: The data the parameter stands for.

labelledBy.description: The node whose text gives these words.

literal.description: Words that are not translated (a product name, a code).

oneOf.description: Catalog keys of which one is shown, depending on the data.

allOf.$comment: params go with key or oneOf

component.description: A kit-neutral component; a kit maps it to the product's own (SPEC.md §8). A `TextField`'s `text` is its label, and the field is named by it.

role.description: The WAI-ARIA 1.2 role the node exposes; `kit check` reads it from the browser's accessibility tree.

name.description: The accessible name (Accessible Name and Description Computation 1.2), kept apart from `text` so that "the visible text is in the name" (WCAG 2.5.3) is checkable.

in.description: The flow states the node is shown in.

unless.description: The flow states the node is not shown in.

when.description: A guard or context flag of the flow that must hold for the node to show.

disabledIn.description: The states where the node is shown but disabled.

emits.description: The event the node sends when pressed: an event of the flow, UPPER_SNAKE.

initialFocus.description: On a page: the node that has focus when it opens.

repeat.description: The node is drawn once per item of this data.

frame.description: For a page: whether it may be framed; `never` (served with CSP frame-ancestors 'none').

allOf.$comment: initialFocus and frame are only on a page

edge.description: A relation between nodes: `{ labelledBy: [node, labelNode] }` or `{ triggers: [node, state] }`.

labelledBy.description: A node and the node that labels it.

triggers.description: An action and the state it leads to.
